# Leveling a Warrior — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots level with).** The party fixtures put this class on arms (2 members), protection (9 members). The main line is **protection** — Endgame build (level 60), 13/5/33, with a respec at level 30. Every order below is what the module grants level by level (the earlier builds first, then the level-60 build). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/warrior/*/talents.yaml`]

**This page is the bots' half.** It records which spec the bots level with, the talent order they execute level by level, the abilities their kit teaches and the consumables they carry. The hand-written guide for this class is [leveling.md](./leveling.md).

## Gameplay by level

The combat rules that come online in each bracket, in the loop's own order (ascending priority). `level_min` is the rule's own gate; the decision loop skips a rule until then. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here and their items are in the band tables below.

### Arms

#### Levels 10–19

- **40 — Overpower** (`A04-overpower`, level 12+) — When: the resident has Battle Stance; in combat; in melee range; the combo points are on the target; Overpower is off cooldown; at least 5 rage.
- **50 — Bloodrage** (`A05-bloodrage`, level 10+) — When: has a target; the target is within 10 yd; fewer than 10 rage; own health above 60%; Bloodrage is off cooldown.
- **88 — Demoralizing Shout** (`A12a-demoralizing-shout`, level 14+) — When: in combat; the lowest party health below 0%; the target is hostile; the target is within 10 yd; not (the target has Demoralizing Roar or the target has Demoralizing Roar or the target has Demoralizing Roar or the target has Demoralizing Shout or the target has Demoralizing Shout or the target has Demoralizing Shout); at least 10 rage.
- **100 — Sunder Armor** (`A10-sunder-armor`, level 10+) — When: in melee range; (fewer than 1 stack of Sunder Armor on the target or the target is elite and fewer than 5 stacks of Sunder Armor on the target); target health above 50%; at least 10 rage; not (at least 2 engaged enemies within 8 yd and the target does not have Thunder Clap and Thunder Clap is off cooldown); the lowest party health below 0%.

#### Levels 20–29

- **26 — Retaliation** (`A13-retaliation`, level 20+) — When: in combat; the resident has Battle Stance; at least 2 engaged enemies within 8 yd; own health below 50%; Retaliation is off cooldown.
- **27 — Intimidating Shout** (`A13i-intimidating-shout`, level 20+) — When: in combat; the lowest party health below 0%; at least 2 engaged enemies within 8 yd; enemies within 30 yd at most engaged enemies within 30 yd; own health below 50%; Intimidating Shout is off cooldown; at least 25 rage; not a polymorphed or otherwise CC'd unit within 12 yd.
- **30 — Execute** (`A03-execute`, level 24+) — When: (the resident has Battle Stance or the resident has Berserker Stance); in melee range; target health below 20%; at least 15 rage; (character level below 60 or at least 60 rage or the target dies within 3 s).
- **140 — Cleave** (`A14-cleave`, level 20+) — When: at least 2 engaged enemies within 5 yd; at least 45 rage; not a polymorphed or otherwise CC'd unit within 8 yd.

#### Levels 30–39

- **-104 — Use Elixir of Giants** (`A00u-elixir-of-giants`, level 38+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Elixir of Giants; Elixir of Giants is off cooldown; the resident does not have Elixir of the Giants; the resident does not have Juju Power.
- **17 — Pummel** (`A02-pummel-t1`, level 38+) — When: (the resident has Battle Stance or the resident has Berserker Stance); the target is casting; in melee range; Pummel is off cooldown; at least 10 rage; the target is not immune to interrupt.
- **18 — Pummel** (`A02-pummel-t2`, level 38+) — When: (the resident has Battle Stance or the resident has Berserker Stance); the target is casting; in melee range; Pummel is off cooldown; at least 10 rage; the target is not immune to interrupt.
- **19 — Pummel** (`A02-pummel-t3`, level 38+) — When: (the resident has Battle Stance or the resident has Berserker Stance); the target is casting; in melee range; Pummel is off cooldown; at least 10 rage; the target is not immune to interrupt.
- **20 — Pummel** (`A02-pummel`, level 38+) — When: (the resident has Battle Stance or the resident has Berserker Stance); the target is casting; in melee range; Pummel is off cooldown; at least 10 rage; the target is not immune to interrupt.
- **64 — Whirlwind** (`A06w-whirlwind`, level 36+) — When: the resident has Berserker Stance; in melee range; Whirlwind is off cooldown; at least 25 rage; not a polymorphed or otherwise CC'd unit within 10 yd.
- **65 — Berserker Stance** (`A06s-berserker-stance-for-whirlwind`, level 36+) — When: the resident has Battle Stance; in combat; has a target; the target is hostile; in melee range; Whirlwind is off cooldown; at least 25 rage; not a polymorphed or otherwise CC'd unit within 10 yd; not (at least 2 engaged enemies within 8 yd and Sweeping Strikes is off cooldown).
- **70 — Master Strike** (`A07-master-strike`, level 36+) — When: in melee range; Master Strike is off cooldown; at least 20 rage.
- **80 — Sweeping Strikes** (`A08-sweeping-strikes`, level 35+) — When: the resident has Battle Stance; at least 2 engaged enemies within 8 yd; Sweeping Strikes is off cooldown; at least 20 rage; not a polymorphed or otherwise CC'd unit within 10 yd.

#### Levels 40–49

- **-109 — Use Elixir of the Mongoose** (`A00u-mongoose`, level 46+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Elixir of the Mongoose; Elixir of the Mongoose is off cooldown; the resident does not have Elixir of the Mongoose.
- **-107 — Use Mighty Rage Potion** (`A00u-mighty-rage`, level 46+) — When: in combat; the target is a dungeon boss; fewer than 30 rage; carries Mighty Rage Potion; Mighty Rage Potion is off cooldown.
- **-103 — Use Smoked Desert Dumplings** (`A00u-smoked-desert-dumplings`, level 45+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Smoked Desert Dumplings; Smoked Desert Dumplings is off cooldown; the resident does not have Well Fed; the resident does not have Well Fed.
- **60 — Mortal Strike** (`A06-mortal-strike`, level 45+) — When: in melee range; Mortal Strike is off cooldown; at least 30 rage.

#### Levels 50–59

- **-110 — Apply Elemental Sharpening Stone** (`A00u-elemental-stone`, level 50+) — When: (the main hand is a one-handed axe or the main hand is a two-handed axe or the main hand is a polearm or the main hand is a one-handed sword or the main hand is a two-handed sword or the main hand is a dagger); not in combat; the resident is not moving; carries Elemental Sharpening Stone; (the main hand does not have Sharpen Weapon - Critical or main-hand imbue time left is less than 300 s); the resident is not eating or drinking.
- **-108 — Use Juju Power** (`A00u-juju-power`, level 55+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Juju Power; Juju Power is off cooldown; the resident does not have Juju Power.
- **-105 — Use Juju Flurry** (`A00u-juju-flurry`, level 55+) — When: in combat; the target is hostile; the target is a dungeon boss; carries Juju Flurry; Juju Flurry is off cooldown; the resident does not have Juju Flurry.
- **62 — Recklessness** (`A09r-recklessness`, level 50+) — When: the resident has Berserker Stance; in combat; in melee range; own health above 50%; Recklessness is off cooldown; the target is a dungeon boss.
- **160 — Slam** (`A16-slam`, level 54+) — When: in melee range; the resident is not moving; at least 15 rage.

#### Levels 60–60

- **29 — Slam** (`A16b-slam-before-execute`, level 60+) — When: (the resident has Battle Stance or the resident has Berserker Stance); in melee range; target health below 20%; the resident is not moving; at least 75 rage.

## Situational rules

Sentences copied from the rules' own notes, where the poison/creature-type, seal, stance, form and consumable advice lives.

### Arms

- **A01-battle-stance:** Stance first: Overpower, Charge, Sweeping Strikes and Retaliation carry stances 65536 and are refused outside it (SpellEntry::GetErrorAtShapeshiftedCast).
- **A02-pummel:** Interrupt; 10 rage, categoryRecoveryTime 10000, stances 327680 (Battle and Berserker), so legal in the stance A01 keeps. A bot only interrupted the mob it had selected, so with the party on another mob nobody stopped the heal or the cast (Jammal'an's Healing Wave, the Hateforge cleric's Greater Heal).
- **A02-pummel-t1:** Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers). 193 adds the Atal'ai camp casts the boss rows lack: Heal 11642, Sleep 12098, Summon 12151 (DB, docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-192.result.txt).

P07 (priority 70) outranks P21 (210); eight of the nine ticks were a stunned tank (Smite Stomp, aura 6432) whose casts the runtime refuses for every rule (`cast_refused caster_not_in_control`, Tick.cpp) so the walk fell to P21, and the ninth has a true P07, no refusal and a later rule chosen, which in Loop.cpp is the persona deviation (deviationShare), and Tick.cpp Request stamps a deviation on a cast PUSH only, never on an approach.

Rage: a stance change sets rage to what Tactical Mastery keeps (0 without it, `core SpellAuras.cpp L2447-L2483`), so the swap costs nothing out of combat and Charge's own rage is capped at the return swap.
- **P04ms-battle-stance-for-mocking-blow:** TACTICAL MASTERY IS REQUIRED: a stance change sets rage to what the talent keeps, 5/10/15/20/25 for ranks 1-5 (`core SpellAuras.cpp L2447-L2483`; talent spells 12295, 12676-12679 are separate aura ids, no spell_chain rows: `doc research/db-queries/tkbplay-266.result.txt`) and Mocking Blow costs 10, so the gate is rank 2 or more, read from the passive auras the resident carries (auras_self lists passives, checked on a live TICK). DANCE (HO-P1-LOOP-056, code 63355d3d8: a rule that casts another stance holds the declared-stance block until the next non-shifting cast, at most formHoldDecisions): this rule takes Battle Stance, the payload rule outranks every rule castable in Battle Stance, the loop puts Defensive Stance back after the payload.
